title: Python data-analysis assignment with LLM-guided reflection
summary: Students implement four Python functions for file I/O and introductory data manipulation, then may complete an optional randomized reflection activity. One condition uses GPT-3.5 to connect concepts, implications, and challenges before a related proctored exam.

sources.title: Supporting Self-Reflection at Scale with Large Language Models: Insights from Randomized Field Experiments in Classrooms
sources.evidence_quote: The assignment required students to program four Python functions.

assessment.summary: Implement four Python functions that read, write, and manipulate file data.
student_actions: Optionally reflect using an LLM, questionnaire, or curated slides.
Complete similar problems in a proctored exam two weeks later.

outputs.artifact: Python functions and optional reflection response

student_role.description: AI was not available for assignment completion; GPT-3.5 was used only in one post-assignment reflection condition.

grading.method: Assignment and proctored-exam performance were recorded; course weighting was not reported.

related_assessments.description: Distinct assessment reported in the same source.

provenance.extraction_method: Full PDF read from pdftotext output.

reported_results: 112 of 1,068 enrolled students entered the optional reflection activity; LLM and questionnaire groups had similar later exam means.

evidence_excerpts.quote: The assignment required students to program four Python functions.
